name: STARSHIP ODYSSEY - X
description:
🌌 STARSHIP ODYSSEY-X 🌌
(An Immersive Sci-Fi Visual Text Adventure)
A sharp electronic chime echoes inside your helmet. Your visor's heads-up display flickers online, casting a cold glow against the shadows. A single warning sirens across your screen: 'CRITICAL: Primary life support atmospheric buffer damaged. Oxygen reserves holding at 70%.'You are entirely alone on the restricted, quarantined vacuum world of Planet X-43. Your scout craft is a shattered wreck of burning metal across iron-rich sands, and your survival clock is ticking.Ahead of you lies a silent, sprawling industrial facility left rotting in the dark. As you step away from the pod fires, you must brave the suffocating expanse across 28 interconnected sectors—from overgrown biome greenhouses choked with razor-sharp purple briars, to highly acidic neon sludge dumps and pitch-black fusion reactor platforms where things slither in the dark.Can you piece together the station's broken architecture, bypass its firewalls, and stay alive long enough to transmit a rescue signal? Or will your journey end as another ghost story in the echoing canyons?
